title: Warranty, arbitration, forum, and payment terms
shortTitle: Warranty, arbitration, forum, and payment terms
summary: The notes identify recurring settings for a material-alteration dispute.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

Air Products illustrates categorical treatment of an implied-warranty disclaimer; other cases discuss forum selection and payment timing. These are examples of disputes, not a list establishing that every such provision is material in every jurisdiction. Dorton and Bayway’s jurisdiction-specific arbitration discussions demonstrate why the scope of a rule matters.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 284–290. Open assigned page 284.
